# Elastic Load Balancing (Classic)

Store Classic Load Balancer listeners, placement, health check, instance and attribute settings as configuration records without routing traffic.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `elb` |
| Signing name | `elasticloadbalancing` |
| Wire protocol | AWS Query |
| API version | `2012-06-01` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Configuration records only |
| Selected operations | 14 of 29 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#elastic-load-balancing-classic) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No traffic: listeners do not accept connections, nothing forwards to instances and no health checks run.
- No policies: stickiness, SSL negotiation and backend authentication policies, SetLoadBalancerPoliciesOfListener and SetLoadBalancerListenerSSLCertificate are excluded, and CloudFormation fails Policies, AppCookieStickinessPolicy, LBCookieStickinessPolicy and Listener PolicyNames explicitly.
- No AttachLoadBalancerToSubnets, DetachLoadBalancerFromSubnets, Enable/DisableAvailabilityZonesForLoadBalancer or ApplySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer; CloudFormation replaces the load balancer when those properties change.
- SSLCertificateId is required for HTTPS and SSL listeners but not looked up in ACM or IAM; no account limits (DescribeAccountLimits) or AdditionalAttributes.
- A load balancer outside a VPC, created with AvailabilityZones, takes no security groups or internal scheme and reports no VPC.
- CanonicalHostedZoneNameID is known for eight Regions and us-east-1's value elsewhere; the source security group is always amazon-elb/amazon-elb-sg.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
